A Letter For You 💌

To My Princess ❤️

If I could keep one thing from this entire world, I wouldn't choose anything expensive or perfect. I'd choose you.

I love the little things about you—the way you talk, the way you smile, the way you make ordinary moments feel special without even trying.

Somehow, out of all the people in this world, my heart found yours. And if life gave me a thousand chances to start again, I'd still want to find you.

In every lifetime, in every version of this story, I hope I get to call you mine.

Forever yours ❤️
